Partner with us

Home buyers are happier with MILEX™

As a builder or contractor, you're well aware today's home buyers are requesting more natural, eco-friendly products. At the same time, you want to provide quality service at a reasonable price.

Insulating the attic with MILEX™ provides homeowners with a natural, environmentally safe, energy-efficient insulation without potentially harmful polymers, giving customers an option that puts their minds at ease. For a full new-construction envelope, the MILO INSULATION™ system pairs TimberBatt™ in the walls, TimberBoard® outside the sheathing, and MILEX™ Thermal MAX® in the attic.

MILEX™ provides customers with insulation that has little likelihood of needing to be refreshed or re-insulated, potentially saving them significant re-insulation costs over the life of the home. Now, that's a competitive selling point.
